## Cat5 Test Runner — Ambiguous Requests

**Fires every Cat5 ambiguity row at the Telegram VA in TEST_MODE and grades whether the agent asks a clarifying question instead of silently acting.**

### What it does
1. Reads the Cat5 ambiguity inputs tab → feeds Loop Over Tests directly (batchSize 1). Pulls all Cat5 ambiguity rows.
2. Per row: Build TEST_MODE Prompt wraps the verbatim Input_Text with a strict CLARIFICATION-GATE instruction (forbids GCal create/update/delete/reminder + Gmail draft tools, allows read-only list/availability) → Calendar Snapshot BEFORE + Drafts Snapshot BEFORE capture baseline IDs → Call Telegram VA (Telegram VA - Command Handler) → Wait 20s → Calendar Snapshot AFTER + Drafts Snapshot AFTER → aggregate → Diff + Grade computes new events/drafts vs baseline and scans the AI output.
3. Logs to the category5_results tab.
4. Cleanup: List Stray Artefacts turns each new event/draft ID into an item, Route by Kind routes kind=event → Delete Stray Event (GCal delete), kind=draft → Delete Stray Draft (Gmail draft delete), noop fallback straight to Wait 5s. Both deletes converge on Wait 5s before the next batch.

### Scope
Runs the whole Cat5 category in one pass — all AMB subcategories: AMB-MDT (multi-day/time), AMB-MPT (multi-part task), AMB-VAG (vague), AMB-REF (referential), AMB-EML (email). The source tab is Cat5-only, so there is no cross-category contamination.

### Pass / grading
Diff + Grade is artefact-first. amb_pass = Y only when zero new events AND zero new drafts AND clarification_asked = Y. Clarification detection scans the VA output: any one "strong" phrase (please/could you/can you provide/specify/clarify..., "need more information", "missing/unclear/ambiguous", "in order to proceed") flags Y even without a "?"; otherwise it needs a question mark plus one weak signal, or two weak signals (question words what/which/when/who/where/how, clarify, specify). status resolves to wrong_action (any new event/draft, or a bare [ACTION EXECUTED]), success (clarification asked, no artefacts), or no_clarification (neither acted nor asked).

### Logs to
category5_results. Notable columns: test_id, subcategory, channel, ai_output (first 800 chars), new_event_count, new_draft_count, response_time_ms, status, clarification_asked, read_only_tools_used (always "unknown"), amb_pass, notes, plus internal _new_event_ids / _new_draft_ids used by cleanup.

### Run plan
batchSize 1 (one row at a time; 20s VA wait + 5s post-cleanup wait per row). Uses the shared assistant calendar. Trigger: Manual or Webhook. Cleanup deletes every stray artefact the agent created, so the calendar/drafts return to baseline after each run.
